info.name: Smart Seaman Mobile API
info.description:
REST API for maritime training and certification management.

**Base URL**: `{{base_url}}`

**Authentication**: Most endpoints require a JWT token. Call `/v1/login` first, then copy `token` from the response into the `token` collection variable.

request.description: Authenticate and receive a JWT token and refresh token.

Activate a newly registered user account via email link.
Send a password reset email to the given address.
Set a new password using the reset UID received by email.
Get the authenticated user's profile.
Update profile data. Set `isChangeFile` to `Y` and provide base64 image in `imageProfile` to update the photo.
Download the user's profile image (binary response).

Re-activate an inactive account by email.

Update an existing certification. Set `isChangeFile` to `Y` to replace the attached file.
Delete a certification by its cert code.
Fetch certification details to pre-populate an edit form.
Download the attached certification file (binary response).
